'''Drutash grubs''' were small creatures which resided in caverns on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] and were considered a delicacy by [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]]. They were offered as a reward to [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] for rescuing Sullustan prisoners from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the rule of the [[Eternal Empire]], excretions from the grubs were used as folk remedies for parasitic infections like [[Rodian rot-worm]].

Drutash grubs were often served with [[omaton sauce]].<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>
